# couchbase-capella-aidp_model_api_key (Data Source)

Fetches a Capella Model Services API key by organization_id and id. Token is not available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_model_api_key" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  id              = var.api_key_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String)
- `allowed_models` (List of String)
- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data for the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `description` (String)
- `expiry` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `region` (String)
